testCase.name: [dev] S05 Nursing Home resident delete: the UI asks once and removes the resident; the server delete removes every row, keeps the trail and logs the removal

descriptionHtml:
Bug B24 · P1 · known

Delete: Hospital uses the browser's native confirm and shows no 'deleted' toast; Nursing Home residents cannot be deleted at all

Tickets: TFA-92579 AC 7–8 ready for qa; TFA-94514 AC 1 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92579): no 'deleted' toast is AC 8; TC-24/S03 fails on the same evidence; Nursing Home has no trash icon and no screen calls snf.remove (TC-24/S05, dev U09).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S16, TC-01/S17, OAT-06/S22, TC-24/S03, TC-24/S28

Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S05 Nursing Home resident delete: the UI asks once and removes the resident; the server delete removes every row, keeps the trail and logs the removal

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Deleting a patient hard-deletes all of that patient's data immediately (removed, not hidden), and the audit log is kept. (UAT TC-24; TFA-92579 AC 2; TFA-94699 AC 4)
  • U7 Deleting a patient asks for confirmation exactly once: tapping the card's trash icon opens a pop-up designed like the app UI that says what deleting does, with Cancel and OK; Cancel keeps everything. (UAT TC-24; TFA-92579 AC 2; TFA-92579 AC 7; TFA-94699 AC 6)
  • T1 After a patient delete, an app-style confirmation message says "[Name]'s patient card was deleted". (TFA-92579 AC 8)
  • T4 Deleting a patient is logged as one 'patient removed' analytics event with the removal reason and the care setting, in both modes. (TFA-94514 AC 1; UAT OAT-06 item 2)
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Fresh physician with the fixture Nursing Home resident (All Residents view) and a second seeded resident 'QA Resident Gone <tag>' for the server step

When UI: look for the control that deletes the resident on the Nursing Home list and in the resident's chart; tap it, Cancel, tap again, OK. Server step (runs whatever the UI offers): call snf:remove on 'QA Resident Gone' as the run's physician and read the tables before and after.

Then UI: as S03 in Nursing Home — one app-style confirmation, Cancel keeps, OK removes the resident and shows the deleted message. Server: the resident and its list row are gone, the audit trail is kept with one delete row added, the list count drops by one, and one 'patient removed' event is logged for Nursing Home.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.3 + TC-24 step 4 + TFA-92579 AC 2/7/8 (no Hospital-only scope) + TFA-94514 AC 1. A missing delete control is a Fail of U5/U7/T1 with Q7 attached ('Is deleting a resident required in V1, where, and does the message say patient card or resident?'), not a runner Block: the agent saves every checkpoint anyway and cp2 and cp4 then fail on their own checks. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

UAT item: TC-24 Deletions · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-24/S05

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa); TFA-94514 Analytics tracking (ready for qa); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

Re-verdict after the QA review of TFA-94514 (2026-10-14; not yet checked by Quinn): known gap. UI half: no screen calls snf.remove and dev U09 shows no trash icon on Nursing Home cards (B24). The server half (a patient_removed row for nursing_home) is still open. The run's own result was skip; its evidence is below.
